Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter - FIR No. 1412/2019

Dear Mr. Qureshi,

Thank you for meeting us on 5 April 2020 about your dispute with Vikram Rao. As we understand it, the complainant alleges cheating over a failed deal. The matter is listed before the Ahmedabad Sessions Court.

Our advice is to produce the contract and payment records to show there was no intent to cheat at the outset. Please collect the signed contract and the payment records and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Tejas Oberoi
